caption: The drawing depicts a metal pitcher or coffee pot with a wide base, narrow top, elongated spout, and a large, curved handle attached from the upper body to the midsection. The main color of the pitcher is a reddish-brown. The body of the pitcher features a large oval decorative motif on the side, filled with painted floral and leaf patterns in yellow, green, red, and orange hues, outlined with black lines. Surrounding this motif is a border of small yellow crescent shapes. The lid has a small knob and is also adorned with a floral design in green and yellow. Similar yellow crescent shapes are painted in a band near the top of the pitcher. The background is plain and off-white.
title: Toleware Coffee Pot
